title: The MID function: characters from the middle
summary: MID returns a number of characters starting at the position you give.
intro: `MID` takes a piece from the middle of a text: you give the start position and the number of characters. It is especially useful with `FIND`, which finds the position of a separator such as "-".
args: The position of the first character you want; the first character is number 1.
examples: Four characters starting at the fifth.
With `FIND`: starts after the first dash, wherever it is.
errors: The start position is less than 1.

faq.q: How do I find the start position without counting by hand?
faq.a: Use `FIND` to get the position of the separator, then add 1.
